text:
jamie: Thinking about a hybrid couch + VR LAN night this Friday — projector in the mezz, Quest loaner, Steam co-op on the big screen, and Switch dock for local multiplayer. 2hr rotating VR slots? :popcorn:
max: I'm in if there's pizza. I can bring an ethernet switch and a couple of long cables.
sasha: I can bring my Quest 2 and the charging dock. Does anyone have a USB-C link cable v2? wireless is okay but wired = no drift for rhythm games. :headphones:
leo: I have a Switch dock + 3 controllers and a small HDMI switch if we need it. Also have a Steam bundle with Moving Out / Overcooked 2 / Heave Ho if people want coop.
priscilla: Quick poll idea — indie co-op showcase (curated chill games) vs chaos party (Smash / Rocket League / Speedrunners). React :one: for indie, :two: for chaos, :three: for VR speedruns.
poll-bot: Poll created: 1) Indie co-op 2) Chaos party 3) VR speedruns — vote with reactions.
max: :one:
sasha: :three: — happy to rotate VR slots, 20min each?
jamie: 20min rotation sounds good. We can reserve 2 headsets at a time and do a queue. Projector picks a spectator mode for couch players. Also need a Switch queue manager.
jen: I can manage the Switch queue and snack table. Heads up: parents room is reserved until 9pm so seating might be tight, bring cushions.
leo: I'll bring sticky notes + sharpie to label controllers and a small power strip. Can someone bring ethernet adapters for the Switch?
jamie: Plan: setup 6:30pm, start 7:00pm, pizza order 6:45pm. RSVP by 4pm Friday so I can order food. @here
dev-bot: Calendar event created: "Couch & VR LAN — Fri" (root_ts: 1961234567).
jamie: Also if anyone can volunteer to run the projector (simple HDMI switch) that'd be great — low effort.
sasha: I can do the projector for the first hour then pass off.
max: bringing a 5m ethernet cable just in case.
priscilla: posting a small poll later for game picks, will include Leo's bundle + Smash + a VR rotation list.
jamie: perfect. see you all Friday! :tada:
